backend/main.mo: Main Motoko canister handling event submission, updating, and Callaway score calculation with sorting and chart lookup.
backend/migration.mo: Placeholder migration module returning an unchanged empty state.
feature_evidence.json: Metadata file listing feature evidence, affected files, components, and test IDs for two Callaway chart–related features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries for various frontend source files.
frontend/docs/callaway-chart-defaults.md: Developer guide explaining how default Callaway charts are defined and modified in the codebase.
frontend/DRAFT_RESTORED.md: Developer note marking restoration of a draft session without functional changes.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based CSS defining color variables, theming, and base styles including dark mode tokens.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML page loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component managing the scoring flow, routes, and calculation logic using TanStack Router and React Query.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer displaying attribution, dynamic year, and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header component showing title, navigation to settings/admin, and a start-over button.
frontend/src/features/admin/AdminView.ts: Admin panel that conditionally shows access-required messaging or the Callaway chart editor with guidance and developer notes.
frontend/src/features/admin/CallawayChar: Editor UI for modifying 9‑ and 18‑hole Callaway grid charts with validation and save/reset actions.
frontend/src/features/eventSetup/EventSe: Form for configuring tournament metadata such as title, course, golfer count, hole count, and par, with validation.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Breakd: Displays a golfer’s detailed Callaway scoring breakdown including deduction, adjustment, and net score explanation.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Callaw: Shows the active Callaway scoring chart for the selected hole count along with a description of how scoring works.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/export: Generates a print‑optimized HTML view in a new window to export tournament standings as a PDF via browser printing.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Leader: Renders the leaderboard with ranked Callaway results, handling tie ranks and showing gross, net, deduction, and adjustment.
Renders the leaderboard view including sorted results, a standings table, PDF export button, and detailed breakdown panels.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/GolferS: Displays editable golfer score cards allowing name and per‑hole score entry, with validation and gross score calculation.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/validat: Validates golfer data, ensuring name, hole count, and hole scores are complete and within allowed ranges.
frontend/src/features/settings/SettingsV: Shows app settings including an admin‑access toggle and a back button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAccessEnabled: Tracks admin‑access state reactively using localStorage and custom events.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, managing login, logout, and stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for backend interactions, including fetching the latest result via the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base setup plus light/dark theme OKLCH variables and font definitions for serif and sans utilities.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callaway.ts: Implements Callaway scoring calculation using persisted chart data, computing gross, deductions, adjustment, and net.
Defines Callaway chart entry types, legacy 9- and 18-hole charts, and a helper to look up the correct row for a gross score.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callawayChartP: Manages loading, saving, and defaulting of editable Callaway charts via localStorage, including grid data and migration handling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, React Query, Internet Identity provider, and global styles.
frontend/src/state/adminAccess.ts: Simple localStorage-backed admin-access flag with getter/setter and change event dispatch.
frontend/src/state/eventTypes.ts: Type definitions for event setup, golfer data, and Callaway result data used throughout the app.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom fonts, OKLCH color tokens, radius, shadows, and animations.
project_state.json: Metadata describing project state, features, issues, and pending requests for Callaway Scoring app.
